meta_description:
9,234 likes, 69 comments - beebomco on October 8, 2026: "Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra: Everything New!

The all-new Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is a flagship Android tablet that measures just 5.1mm in thickness. It comes with a 14.6” 3K AMOLED panel with very slim bezels, which gets you a large, immersive screen.
The display gets up to 1600 nits of brightness and supports HDR content. An anti-reflective coating cuts down on glare. Audio is handled by four speakers with Dolby Atmos support.

Inside, the tablet is powered by the Dimensity 9500 chipset, paired with 12GB of RAM and up to 512GB of storage. Storage can be expanded up to 2TB.

The Tab S12 Ultra runs One UI 9 based on Android 17. AI features include Audio Eraser, which removes background audio from videos, and Creative Studio, which creates stickers and invitations. You can also run up to 3 apps at once for multitasking. Samsung promises 7 years of OS updates, and Samsung DeX lets you connect the tablet to a larger display.

The S Pen comes in the box. This is also the first Android tablet to come with Photoshop, which includes generative fill.

The tablet packs an 11,600mAh battery and has an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance.

For those who want a smaller option, there is also the Galaxy Tab S12+. It has a 12.6” AMOLED display, the same processor and a 10,600mAh battery.

#Samsung #GalaxyTabS12 Plus #GalaxyTabS12Ultra #GalaxyTabS12 #GalaxyAI".
